cohort: 89 patients with abnormal placental invasion (API) who had undergone caesarean delivery (CD) between April 2010 and February 2017.
finding: The study found a weak positive correlation between an increase in packed red blood cell (PRBC) and fresh frozen plasma (FFP) transfusions and time of hospital stay in patients with API.
mod_finding: Emergency CD was associated with a greater number of PRBC transfusions and a higher rate of ICU admission compared to elective CD.
